args.subject: Private Dining Request for 12 Guests – Friday, May 17, 2024
args.body:
Dear New Asiaway Private Dining Team,

I hope this message finds you well. I am writing to request a private dining table for 12 guests on Friday, May 17, 2024, with a preferred seating time of 7:00 PM, which falls within your evening service.

Could you please confirm whether a private dining room is available for that date and time, and let me know about any set menu options, minimum spend, or deposit requirements?

Restaurant address: 123 Rue de la Gaite, 75014 Paris, France

Best regards,
Emma Johnson
Email: emma.johnson@bluesparrowtech.com
Phone: 327-420-4923
